extraction: Orchestrator Pipeline MVP inner loop and GAN integration. MVP inner loop uses /gan-build "<brief>" --skip-planner which drives gan-generator -> gan-evaluator; tune --max-iterations / --pass-threshold. GAN-style Generator-Evaluator agent harness for building high-quality applications autonomously based on Anthropic's March 2026 harness design paper. Use when a feature should be built autonomously through generator and evaluator iteration until it clears a quality bar. The orch-pipeline shared engine delegates to existing ECC agents/commands rather than replacing them: /feature-dev, /plan, /code-review, /build-fix, /refactor-clean, /gan-build, plus tdd-workflow skill. Adds shared size classifier and two gates on top of them so one umbrella covers all five operations consistently. Verification: size tier stated and matched, Gate 1 and Gate 2 honored, security-reviewer ran iff security trigger touched, commits conventional and scoped, coverage >=80%.
